old_problem: A generic `CX8` match or title-based sensor cannot distinguish multiple ConnectX-8 boards, PCIe functions, ports, cables and aggregate versus per-board thermal records. Exact OPN/PSID/firmware thresholds and full IB/OOB/Web mapping were absent. Historical review additionally treated missing numbers 3–16 as possible hidden criteria without source text.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict. NVIDIA documentation confirms ConnectX-8 on-card thermal monitoring via SMBus and version/model-specific warning/critical/fatal semantics; the BMC exposure can therefore be reconciled per exact board identity with a Project SPEC. Complete IB/OOB lists and real Web evidence preserve every source view. Ethernet and InfiniBand port contexts remain separately labeled under ED-05 and cannot substitute for sensor coverage. Criteria 1/2/17 are explicit and the numbering gap remains a documented typo, not invented requirements.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2015, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, ED-01 through ED-30, NVIDIA ConnectX-8 manuals and ipmitool documentation were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2016 / Wistron-BMC-01036-V002 / a78fba275501d201.
NVIDIA ConnectX-8 manuals document internal card thermal sensors readable through SMBus and explicit thermal-state behavior, supporting read-only BMC/IPMI correlation.
Exact OPN/PSID/firmware, board serial, BDF/slot and port identities are needed because exposed records and thresholds may vary by model and platform integration.
Ethernet and InfiniBand link mode, speed/FEC/counters are passive context only and are recorded separately; neither proves the management sensor fields required by this row.
The source explicitly requires SDR, Sensor List and Web SPEC parity. The 1/2/17 labels do not authorize construction of absent 3–16.
No ipmitool, authentication, CX8/SMBus/MFT/link read, Web login/capture, port reset/flap/configuration, log clear, BMC, network or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Per-ConnectX-8 board/port management sensor parity across IB/OOB IPMI and BMC Web
test_case.purpose: For every installed ConnectX-8 board, prove each required board/port/cable sensor is attributed to the correct serial/OPN/PSID/BDF and matches the exact firmware/platform SPEC across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web, with protocol-separated passive health context.
required_package: Exact SUT/BMC and ConnectX-8 board serial/OPN/PSID/firmware/BDF/slot/function plus port/cable/module inventory
Version-bound NVIDIA/OEM sensor SPEC with required individual/aggregate records, SMBus/BMC mapping, units, states, thresholds, update periods and applicability
Separately labeled Ethernet and InfiniBand port-mode/link-speed/FEC/error expectations for passive correlation only
Approved ipmitool/read-only NIC queries, trusted protected OOB/Web access, aligned/cache/freshness/pagination policy, evidence hashes and retained logs
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; bind every CX8 board by serial/OPN/PSID/firmware/BDF/slot and freeze port/cable population. Preserve logs. Capture complete untruncated IB and OOB `sdr elist`/`sensor list`, then apply only the approved per-board/port crosswalk. Capture all BMC Web Sensor pages with board/port identity and timestamps. Compare exact population, names/descriptions/types/units/readings/states/thresholds/freshness with the version-bound SPEC and across views. If approved, collect read-only PCIe plus Ethernet or InfiniBand link context in separate evidence sections; never conflate protocols or use it as sensor proof. Do not assume the testcase title is a sensor ID, rely on grep/head alone, clear logs, modify/flap/reset ports or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every installed/applicable CX8 board and port/cable object has exactly its required individual or approved aggregate sensor representation; all IB/OOB/Web fields meet exact model/firmware SPEC, complete Web evidence agrees, separately labeled passive link context is healthy and no disallowed thermal/log condition appears.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact board/port identity and population, complete raw IB/OOB plus visual Web evidence, complete unique mapping and every required field within version-bound SPEC/freshness rules. FAIL on wrong board, unjustified N/A, missing/extra/duplicate/misattributed record, wrong aggregate scope/unit/state/threshold, stale/out-of-range value, cross-view mismatch, protocol conflation, degraded passive link/new error or incomplete evidence. Missing SPEC/map is NOT READY; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Passive read-only operations only; prohibit cable/board removal, port flap/reset/configuration, firmware/sensor/threshold writes and log clearing.
Bind every record to serial/OPN/PSID/BDF/port after complete raw capture; protect all access credentials.
Keep Ethernet and InfiniBand evidence separate; stop on identity ambiguity, missing mapping, degraded PCIe/link/FEC state, new errors or thermal alarm.
No automatic retry; preserve first discrepancy, complete Web evidence and logs.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant, SUT/BMC and CX8 serial/OPN/PSID/firmware/BDF/slot/function/port/cable inventory
Versioned sensor SPEC plus individual/aggregate five-view crosswalk and applicability
Complete timestamped IB/OOB SDR elist and Sensor list raw outputs, exits and hashes
Complete BMC Web screenshots/export with pagination and physical board/port binding
Separately labeled passive PCIe/Ethernet/IB/FEC/error/thermal context, numbering-defect/no-action/no-clear/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong board/port identity, access, mapping, sensor/Web mismatch, degraded link/FEC, thermal or log anomaly, stop passive collection and preserve the first state. Close/revoke sessions and rotate exposed credentials. Do not flap/reset/reconfigure a port, clear logs or retry insecurely; escalate exact serial/BDF/port and record IDs to network/BMC owners.
